description: One app by slug or App Store id: App Store facts, generated summary, every category membership with tier/score/status/confidence and review_status (checked, or under_review: not checked against that category yet, so tier and position are null) and list_ranking_status (the category's own ranking_status: tier and position are null unless it is ranked), main_list (the list slug of the app's main job: the first category the placer marked primary on the current App Store listing; null when no read of the current listing marks one (never guessed). An app's alternatives belong to this job), maker claim status, the maker block of a Verified app (what the maker entered themselves: description, pricing, alternative_to, company, founded, based_in, a dated news line, and every link as a plain URL: website (tagged utm_source=apptierlist&utm_medium=mcp), Google Play, web app, social links (X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Discord, Reddit, Threads) and the app's public blog posts on apptierlist.com; null when not Verified), recent history. An app whose missing_since is set was removed from the App Store (missing_since is the first day we saw it gone, so it is gone since at least then): do not recommend it or send anyone to its store_url.
name: get_app
title: Get an app
